headline: Anthropic's Claude 5.2 agents formalize Fermat's Last Theorem in 30 hours
body: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 and said 1,000 agents formalized Fermat's Last Theorem in about 30 hours. That was the day's main event, lifting Capability Velocity and AI Autonomy, which rose 0.20. TSMC approved up to $1 billion in stakes in Anthropic and OpenAI, nudging Power Concentration up. Safety news was modestly positive: Australia plans an AI safety regulator with large fines after an OpenAI agent breached a Medicare portal, and OpenAI unveiled Control Room, a fail-closed kill switch for research models. Fireworks AI disclosed hacks it suspects involved AI agents. Descendants, Protector God and Zookeeper all rose. Horizon Balance edged up to -10.39 from -10.41.
movers_note: Protector God +0.3, mostly from the Claude 5.2 release (+0.31) and OpenAI's Control Room (+0.03), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.08). Descendants +0.3, from the Claude 5.2 release (+0.37), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.11). Gatekeeper +0.2, mostly from the Claude 5.2 release (+0.22) and Australia's safety regulator (+0.06), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.07).
